  tanh x := x.tanh
  tanh_def := sorry_proof

  sqrt x := if 0 ≤ x then x.sqrt else 0
  sqrt_def := sorry_proof

  pow x y := x.pow y

  abs x := x.abs

  decidableLT := inferInstance

  min_def := by sorry_proof
